abstract_en: Blended Intensive Programme of the University of Iceland with Copenhagen Business School, Paris-East Créteil University and the University of Naples Federico II: social entrepreneurship as a way to address social and environmental issues.
description_en: Monthly online meetings from January 2027 lead to an on-site intensive week in Reykjavík (10 to 14 May 2027). Students from all disciplines work in interdisciplinary teams with industry and academic leaders on societal challenges. Erasmus+ BIP code 2026-1-IS01-KA131-HED-000426928-1.
learning_outcomes_en: Analyse societal challenges; take initiative on change and innovation; collaborate across disciplines; understand one's own capabilities.
prerequisites_en: Nomination by the home institution. Undergraduates need at least 120 ECTS completed.
assessment_en: Brief assignments during the virtual sessions, group work during the on-site week and a final deliverable presented on the last day. Pass/fail; a transcript of records is issued.

abstract_en: Distance-learning course of the University of Iceland that critiques heteronormativity and binary structures in church and academic settings.
description_en: Two 90-minute real-time online lessons per week for six weeks (Icelandic time, GMT+0), open to undergraduate and Master students of all disciplines.
learning_outcomes_en: Explain the basics of queer theology; critique heteronormativity in core texts; relate sexuality and gender to religious norms; position oneself and discuss sensitive topics in informed dialogue to academic standards.
assessment_en: 70% assignments during the semester and 30% home exam; a minimum grade of 5 on every assignment is required to sit the exam. A transcript of records is issued.

title_en: Languages and Culture: The European Intellectual Tradition
abstract_en: Distance-learning course of the University of Iceland on influential European thinkers as scholars and public intellectuals, and on the Eurocentrism of their work.
description_en: Weekly 90-minute lessons on Thursday mornings (Icelandic time) from 14 January to 15 April 2027, recorded for those who cannot attend live; readings include Mill, Arendt, Benjamin, de Beauvoir, Hall, Mouffe and Rosa. Taught on Canvas.
learning_outcomes_en: Critical understanding of the European intellectual tradition through key authors; place one's own field in theoretical debate; analyse and present research topics.
prerequisites_en: Master students, and undergraduates with at least 120 ECTS, of all disciplines.
assessment_en: Short weekly commentaries on the readings, one presentation and a final oral exam. A transcript of records is issued.

title_en: Applied Gender Studies for International Students
abstract_en: Online graduate course of the University of Iceland introducing gender and equality theory with practical equality training.
description_en: Weekly online lessons on Canvas from 11 January to 23 April 2027 (Icelandic time) for graduate students of all disciplines: concepts of gender equality, assessment of equality actions, gender mainstreaming and gender budgeting applied to a plan of action.
learning_outcomes_en: Explain gender equality concepts; assess gender equality actions; apply gender mainstreaming and gender budgeting to a plan of action.
assessment_en: Participation in online discussions 10%, a smaller assignment 20% and a final project 70%. A transcript of records is issued.

abstract_en: Distance-learning graduate course of the University of Iceland on learning, teaching and leisure activities for sustainability.
description_en: Weekly real-time lessons on Friday afternoons (Icelandic time) from 15 January to 23 April 2027 on Canvas, for graduate students of all disciplines. Topics include activism, place-based education and behavioural change.
learning_outcomes_en: Knowledge of learning and teaching for sustainability; critical analysis of approaches; debating controversial issues.
assessment_en: 80% attendance is mandatory; discussion papers, oral presentations and a final paper, each with a minimum grade of 5.0. A transcript of records is issued.
